Resolves #21351

The home's two demo pages keep the home's shape and get new content: **Gantt & Task Board** (new in version 14) and **Data Grid** take the places of Colors and Helix. Each page is a text block beside a tabbed live preview, as before: it opens on its source in Monaco and switches to the running result once the page has been the active one for a second. The plan is one task store bound to a Gantt chart and a task board: the selected card's bar is highlighted and follows a click, a card moved to another column recolours its bar, and a moved bar takes its successors along. The grid holds 300 records under a feed written in its snippet: prices tick and flash, a change is green or red by its sign, each row draws its trend, and the footer shows the rate the feed measured. Both snippets import engine classes only, have 48 lines and end `export default Neo.setupClass(MainView);`.

**Changed on 19 Nov, on the operator's read of the previous head (`99f59e2b58`):** code beside the result made the landing page a wall of code. Side by side is no longer part of this pull request: `src/code/LivePreview.mjs` and its stylesheet equal `dev`, and `FeatureSection` has no `sideBySide` and no text band on top.

Evidence: L3 (unit and e2e in dev mode on this head, frames from headless Chromium at 1440×900 and 390×844) → L3 required (rendered-surface criteria). Residual: the deployed production build, Residual-Owner: #20682.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; change class `capability`; the repository's pre-commit and pre-push checks ran on these commits.

## Deltas from ticket

- **The pages keep the home's released shape (operator, 19 Nov).** AC-4 asks for snippet and result at rest; the operator read that as a wall of code on the landing page. Four rows of the ticket's Contract Ledger are therefore not in this diff: `Neo.code.LivePreview#sideBySide` and `#editorConfig`, and `FeatureSection`'s `sideBySide` and `textContainerPosition: 'top'`. The ticket's body is the design seat's; the change is recorded on the ticket as a comment for her fold.
- **A live preview no longer grows its page or leaves the screen** (`FeatureSection.css`). A page with a live preview is at most one snap page tall, so a grid taller than the page scrolls inside its card, and a preview is never wider than its page. On `dev` the Colors preview ends 820px past the right edge at 1440×900 and 1,085px past it at 390×844 (the as-released frames).
- **The snippets end `export default Neo.setupClass(MainView);`** (operator, 19 Nov); `Neo.code.executor.Neo` takes the exported class as the module.
- **The grid's paragraph names no rate** ("twenty records at a time"); the footer carries the measured number.
- **The grid group's route is `#/examples/grid`.** Both pages linked the family id `grid-table`, which names no route, so the link opened the examples overview.
- **`Portal.view.home.FeatureSection#learnMoreText`** (reactive, default `'Learn more'`) names the button, and **`#links`** with `#linksLabel` puts a row of family routes under the paragraph.
- **The price flash has two tints of equal weight**, in the engine's stylesheet (`resources/css/src/grid/column/AnimatedCurrency.css`): `rgb(218 54 51 / 60%)` and `rgb(35 134 54 / 60%)` in place of `darkred` and `darkgreen`, whose green was 1.7 times as bright. `apps/finance` flashes with them. The grid's Change column is a plain currency column with a renderer, so green text never sits on a green flash.
- **The footer label carries the row count from the start.** A label that got its first text after the grid had rendered grew the toolbar, and a row's sparkline registered on a node that was gone; noted in defect-note `0a8f8e62`.
- **No flag column in the grid.** `Neo.grid.column.CountryFlag` loads its images from a third-party host; a failed request is a console error on the front door.
- **The planning page's stylesheet sets the board's column width** (190px), so four columns fit its card.
- **`HomeComponentPreviews.spec.mjs` is adapter-eligible** (`test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs`): it asks the page's own shared App Worker to move a card and a bar, tests no Bridge and imports no Brain service.
- Out of scope, noted in defect-note `be7e2d7d` (a store model given string field names keeps one field named `undefined`) and in defect-note `760e9f36`: `Neo.data.TreeStore` stamps `collapsed: true` on a raw parent row, so `Neo.gantt.TaskModel`'s documented default `false` never applies; the snippet sets `collapsed: false`.

## Cold look

The operator read the previous head's frames on 19 Nov as a wall of code that a decider leaves, and named the shape to build: the released one, with the new content. That read stands in for a reader run on this head. No model reader ran: a model reads a code wall without effort, and it graded the previous head 8 and 6 with "go on".

My read of this head at a glance, without reading code: each page shows a headline, a few lines of text and one large running component. The plan fills its card and shows a selected card with its highlighted bar at rest; the grid shows flashes and a measured rate. What I still see: the row of links wraps to two lines in the text column, the ring on a highlighted bar is thin, and the phases are empty boxes. The design seat's read of this head is requested (AC-1).

**1. The layout: yes, this is the page I want at the front door.** Code and its result side by side at rest is the one thing this format does that no screenshot can, and the even split makes the ratio readable in one glance: 29 lines on the left, a running grid on the right. The band costs 150 px and leaves the pane 715. `sideBySide` as a config of the live preview is the right owner. Two conditions follow from it:

- **The result has 700 × 680 px.** What a snippet builds has to be designed for that box: dense, and coloured with meaning.
- **"The whole snippet shows" should be a spec assertion,** not a measurement in a body: the cold reader caught the scheduler's cut at line 32 of 34. At this size that is about 32 lines of about 75 characters.

**2. The content: it does not pass, so this pull request cannot resolve #21351 with these two snippets.** The operator's read of the pair, 18 Nov: "looks to boring for a landing page demo. one colored not connected items. … the grid is already boring as a demo. yay, buffered rendering? so what? tons of solutions can do it. nothing special. now 2 boring demos => if i was a CTO seeing neo for the first time, i would walk. not even going to the examples page." I read the scheduler frame and the grid frame myself and agree. Both pages answer the test's first half (does a CTO need it) and fail its second (does he stay): twenty rows named "Account 1" to "Account 20" with one bar colour, and eighteen unconnected bars in one colour. The cold reader's 7 and 8 say the same against the 9 of 10 that the examples gate uses. The fault is in my brief for the leaf, which asked the first half only.

Fallback if one store under both views fails its drive: the Gantt chart alone.
- `parts/Grid.mjs` becomes **a grid that is alive:** rich cells (`CountryFlag`, `AnimatedCurrency`, `AnimatedChange`, `Sparkline`, `Progress`) under a feed in the snippet. Its claim is no longer a row count.

The verdict on the new pair is the team's, as the operator said on the first: one cold reader as the CTO, both questions, 9 of 10, and my read.

**A dated exit, so the format does not wait forever on the content:** if the new pair has not passed that read by Fri 20 Nov, 18:00 CET, this pull request merges as it is, as the carrier of the format, and the content gets a leaf of its own.

| Links label | More components: | More components: |
| Links | Grids · Forms · Scheduler · Calendar · Docking | More grids · Forms · Scheduler · Gantt · Task Board · Calendar · Docking |

**If the drive ends in the fallback** (the Gantt chart alone): headline "Gantt Chart", sub-headline "Linked Tasks · {n} Lines", paragraph "New in version 14 and MIT-licensed: a task tree, bars with progress, and the links between them. Move a bar and its successors follow. Change the code and the chart follows, or move it into its own window."

Three things the copy fixes for the build:

- **"Done" is green.** The paragraph names the colour, so the bar's status classes and the board's column accents use the same four colours, and green is the last column's.
- **"New in version 14", not "New in Engine 14".** The cold reader did not know what "Engine 14" is; a version needs no explanation. #21351's criterion follows.
- **Every sentence is something the visitor can do in the pane.** If the drive shows that one of them does not hold (a card recolouring its bar, a bar taking its successors along), the sentence goes, not the truth.
